parameters.help_en: The language of the response. Valid values: zh: Chinese. en: English
parameters.help_zh: 响应说明的语言。zh：中文；en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud service type. Valid values: 5: ApsaraDB RDS. 8: PolarDB. 27: PolarDB-X 2.0. If you specify this parameter and ProductCode at the same time, the values must match
parameters.help_zh: 云产品类型标识。5：RDS；8：POLARDB；27：PolarDBX2。与 ProductCode 同时指定时应对应
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en: The code of the cloud service. Column encryption supports ApsaraDB RDS, PolarDB, and PolarDB-X 2.0. If you specify this parameter and ProductId at the same time, the values must match
parameters.help_zh: 云产品编码。列加密支持 RDS、POLARDB、PolarDBX2；如同时传入 ProductId，二者必须对应
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The ID of the sensitivity level. You can obtain the ID from the response of the ListRiskLevels operation
parameters.help_zh: 敏感等级标识，可从 ListRiskLevels 的返回列表获取
parameters.name: risk_level_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the detection rule or model. Set the value to the ID of the corresponding detection rule in the target template
parameters.help_zh: 识别规则或模型标识，取目标模板内对应识别规则的 Id
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Keep other filter conditions consistent when you query the next page
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的记录数。查询下一页时保持其他筛选条件一致
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前查询页码，从 1 开始
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data classification template. You can obtain the ID from the Items[].Id parameter in the response of the ListTemplates operation. The value must be consistent with the selected sensitivity level and detection model
parameters.help_zh: 分类分级模板标识，可从 ListTemplates 的 Items[].Id 获取；与所选敏感等级和识别模型保持一致
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The start position of the cursor-based pagination. Use the NextMarker value returned in the previous request for subsequent requests. Keep the value consistent with the original filter conditions
parameters.help_zh: 游标分页的起始位置。后续请求使用上次返回的 NextMarker；与原筛选条件保持一致
parameters.name: marker

parameters.help_en: The name of the database. Set the value to the DbName value returned by the ListDataSources operation
parameters.help_zh: 数据库名称，取 ListDataSources 返回的 DbName
parameters.name: data_source_name

parameters.help_en: The instance identity of the cloud database instance. Set the value to the InstanceId value in the instance list
parameters.help_zh: 云上数据库实例标识，取实例列表中的 InstanceId
parameters.name: data_asset_source_id

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the returned data

Items.description_en: The list of records returned by the query
Items.description_zh: 本次查询返回的记录列表

Comment.description_en: The description of the database table

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the data object was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 数据对象的创建时间。自 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC 起的 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒

DataAssetSourceId.description_en: The instance identity of the cloud instance

InstanceDescription.description_en: The description of the database instance

Name.description_en: The name of the database table. Some engines return the name in the schema.table format
Name.description_zh: 数据表名称，部分引擎返回 schema.table 形式

Owner.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the database table
Owner.description_zh: 数据表所有者的云账号标识

ProductCode.description_en: The code of the cloud service

RiskLevelId.description_en: The ID of the sensitivity level

RiskLevelName.description_en: The name of the sensitivity level

RuleList.description_en: The list of detection models or rules

Count.description_en: The number of hits for the detection rule
Count.description_zh: 命中该识别规则的数量

Name.description_en: The name of the detection model or rule

RiskLevelId.description_en: The ID of the sensitivity level

Sensitive.description_en: Indicates whether the data is detected as sensitive data

SensitiveCount.description_en: The number of sensitive data entries within the current statistical scope
SensitiveCount.description_zh: 当前统计范围内的敏感数据数量

TenantName.description_en: The name of the tenant to which the data asset belongs
TenantName.description_zh: 数据资产所属租户名称

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries that meet the current statistical or query scope
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合当前统计或查询范围的总数量

Marker.description_en: The pagination cursor used for the current query
Marker.description_zh: 本次查询使用的分页游标

NextMarker.description_en: The cursor used to query the next page
NextMarker.description_zh: 继续查询下一页使用的游标

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page for the current query
PageSize.description_zh: 本次查询的每页记录数

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use the ID to locate the API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，可用于定位本次 API 调用

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries that meet the current statistical or query scope
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合当前统计或查询范围的总数量

Truncated.description_en: Indicates whether more pages exist. A value of true indicates that more data exists. A value of false indicates that no more data exists
Truncated.description_zh: 是否存在后续分页。字符串 true 表示仍有后续数据，false 表示没有
